note_on_id: The directory name uses 12525_2 but the correct California Government Code section is § 12525.5 (Racial and Identity Profiling Act — RIPA). This manifest documents § 12525.5.
filed_by: Claude (assistant) under steward direction — Michael Hartmann, Vernen Legal Compliance
build_context: Built 2026-04-12 as part of the CA_Law_Enforcement_Procedures_Specialist seven-standard seeding. § 12525.5 is the RIPA data collection mandate — the primary tool for documenting pretextual stop patterns at California law enforcement agencies.

rule.note: Mandatory data collection on every stop, annual AG reporting, five-year retention, officer identification maintained separately — all captured in current/text.txt

reasoning.note: RIPA addresses institutionalized invisibility of racial profiling: without data, disparate-impact claims could not be proven; mandatory collection converts invisible encounters into auditable records — documented in historical_chain.md and context.md

historical_loss.note: Pre-RIPA: no systematic stop data; officer discretion without accountability; pattern evidence for DV claims against Black/brown communities structurally impossible to compile — documented in historical_chain.md
